item.title: Water leaking across road, 22nd October
item.description:
There is water leaking from a private property running across the road. This has been going on for a number of weeks. Thames Water are aware and have attended and confirmed this is not on the highway and not their responsibility. It is a private property issue stemming from 24 Leysdown Avenue area (not confirmed by Thames Water due to data protection). Leak is getting increasingly worse, if left and freezes this has the potential to become a major hazard as located on a steep hill and junction. As a matter of urgency could you issue an officer to liaise with residents and Thames Water to ensure this is resolved promptly before it freezes?
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Leysdown Avenue, Barnehurst, Greater London

item.title: Constant pavement blocking by commercial bins, 22nd October
item.description:
Residents of Devonshire road, N13 have been reporting the problem with the commercial bins for years, but nothing is being done about it. ( A ) They are collected only once a week and therefore, they're constantly full with much rubbish being left in the floor, and (B) After being emptied, they are not being placed back properly, often left, blocking the pavement as evident in the photos. The photos I've attached represent a very real and a regular problem. In addition, the bins, when overflowing attract rats and are completely an eyesore as you enter from Alderman's Hill and face the rubbish straight in front of you. We would like the bins either cleared away completely and the businesses given bags to clear their rubbish (to be kept on their premise) or for the bins to be screey off and emptied regularly I e. every other day.

Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Green Lanes, Southgate
Report on FixMyStreet
